svg.title: Horizontal push: muscles trained and joint angles
svg.desc: Anterior view of the chest and left shoulder with the pectoralis major and anterior deltoid highlighted, the shoulder and elbow lines marked, and a side column showing the start and end position, joint angle curves and muscle action timing.
svg.text: Elbow extensors sit on the back of the arm, so the triceps is listed but not shown.
Base figure: OpenStax, Anatomy and Physiology, figure 11.5. Labels removed, cropped. CC BY 4.0.
